educational_overlay.purpose: Maps legal claims, statutory elements, evidentiary burdens, and supporting exhibits into a cohesive courtroom issue chart.
educational_overlay.when_to_use: When framing issues in civil suits, preparing trial witness examinations, or drafting appellate grounds.
educational_overlay.when_not_to_use: For initial client intake before any documentation has been produced.
educational_overlay.prompt_template:
Prepare comprehensive claim chart for '{{CAUSE_OF_ACTION}}' where burden lies on '{{BURDEN_OF_PROOF}}'.
Break claim into statutory and common law elements: (1) valid contract, (2) performance by plaintiff, (3) breach by defendant, (4) measurable loss.
For each element list supporting documentary exhibits, potential defence rebuttals, and evidentiary gaps.
educational_overlay.fictional_scenario: In a software delivery dispute, plaintiff claims Rs. 1 Crore in lost profits due to system downtime caused by vendor negligence.
educational_overlay.sample_output:
### Claim Chart Matrix
| Legal Element | Required Evidence | Available Exhibit | Gap Assessment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Valid Contract | Signed Agreement | Exhibit P-1 | None |
| Breach of Duty | Incident RCA | Exhibit P-4 | Unsigned by vendor |
| Quantified Loss | Audited Books | [MISSING] | Forensic audit required |
guardrails: Every factual assertion must map to a specific marked exhibit.
verification_checklist: Check proof of electronic records under Section 65B Indian Evidence Act / Section 63 BSA.
Verify witness competence for each exhibit.
educational_overlay.ai_risk_warning: AI cannot predict how a trial judge will evaluate oral witness demeanor in cross-examination.
